title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Sul
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Sul



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

  • GitOps com Argo CD.

  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.

  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Analista de CFTV
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


VAGA REMOTA


O que buscamos?

O Analista de Suporte a Aplicações CFTV será responsável por garantir o aprovisionamento, a disponibilidade, a operação e a manutenção dos sistemas de CFTV , atuando em ambientes onshore e offshore.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o aprovisionamento de sistemas de monitoramento de imagens em embarcações, plataformas e demais ambientes onshore e offshore, garantindo a correta integração dos dispositivos.
  • Configurar e parametrizar câmeras e sistemas de CFTV em servidores de monitoramento.
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em câmeras e equipamentos de videomonitoramento, identificando e solucionando falhas técnicas.
  • Atender chamados técnicos relacionados a aplicações e sistemas de CFTV, realizando análise, diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes.
  • Direcionar e escalonar chamados para o time de campo sempre que houver necessidade de atuação presencial.
  • Administrar plataformas de videomonitoramento como Genetec, IndigoVision e soluções correlatas.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, registros de ocorrências e acompanhar o cumprimento dos SLAs acordados.


Requisitos

  • Formação técnica de nível médio em TI, Telecomunicações, Eletrônica, Elétrica, Eletrotécnica ou Informática ou Formação superior ou pós-graduação nas áreas citadas.
  • Conhecimento prático em ambientes Genetec.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes IndigoVision.


Diferenciais

  • Certificação ITIL.
  • Certificações Genetec ETC e/ou OTC.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Tech Lead - Python


A Shipay simplifica a forma de as empresas receberem e pagarem por meios digitais, como Pix, Bolepix e Carteiras Digitais. Com a regulamentação da Duplicata Escritural, vamos viabilizar o Pagamento em Duas Etapas, além de um hub de escrituração de duplicatas. 


Buscamos um(a) Líder Técnico(a) para guiar nossa equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e eficientes. Importante: Este papel foca na excelência tecnológica e mentoria técnica, não sendo responsável pela gestão de pessoas .


Responsabilidades


  • Excelência Técnica: Projetar, implementar e testar serviços de back-end de forma iterativa, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Desenvolvimento Ativo: Atuar de forma \"hands-on\" no desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas e assíncronas, sendo a referência técnica para o time nas entregas das sprints.
  • Padrões e Práticas: Definir e implementar as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Realizar estimativas de projetos, identificar riscos técnicos e criar planos de mitigação para débitos técnicos.
  • Mentoria e Resolução: Atuar como mentor técnico para o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe e resolver problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com a gestão para garantir a eficiência das entregas nos times.


Requisitos


  • Experiência em Python: Domínio em desenvolvimento utilizando Python, Flask, FastAPI e SqlAlchemy.
  • Arquitetura: Sólida experiência com Programação Orientada a Objetos, Modelagem de Dados e arquitetura de microsserviços em ambiente Cloud.
  • Qualidade de Software: Vivência no desenvolvimento e teste de aplicações distribuídas, assíncronas e aplicação de testes de software.
  • Visão de Engenharia: Experiência na aplicação de Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Habilidade Analítica: Capacidade de realizar estimativas precisas e gerir débitos técnicos de forma estratégica.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Habilidade para depuração e solução de problemas técnicos de alta complexidade.


Benefícios


  • Caju: Flexibilidade VR/VA em um só cartão.
  • Bônus: Até 2,5 salários por performance (individual e da empresa).
  • Saúde: Plano Porto Seguro.
  • Odonto: Plano Metlife.
  • Filhos: Auxílio-creche.
  • Segurança: Seguro de vida.
  • Desenvolvimento: Acesso Alura (plataforma de aprendizado).
  • Família: Licenças maternidade/paternidade estendidas (Empresa Cidadã).
  • Day-off: Folga para comemorar o seu aniversário.


Local de Trabalho


  • 100% Remoto .
  • Caso prefira, nosso escritório em São Paulo (próximo das estações Anhangabaú e São Bento) está disponível para uso.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Especialista (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de

software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;
  • Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);

● NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;

● IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Software Engineer Sênior Golang
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?


A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Analista de Projetos Sênior
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. O Analista de Projetos elabora planos de execução e acompanha deperto os projetos do Grupo Fleury, atuando também no controle e nos estudos, garantindo que todas asinformações obtidas desse projeto sejam registradas e estejam em um local de fácil consulta


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar detalhamento do escopo do projeto, levantamento dos requisitos técnicos/funcionais relacionados aos projetos, mapear stakeholders e analisar, criticamente, a relevância e impacto em valor gerado, a fim de atender as necessidades do negócio;
  • Elaborar documentação, relatórios, atas, listas de pendências e outros registros a fim de garantir
  • rastreabilidade dos projetos, conforme metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO);
  • Analisar e acompanhar de forma diligente o escopo do projeto através de ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos e gerenciamento das eventuais mudanças, a fim de garantir a efetividade das ações definidas;
  • Garantir integração, comunicação e colaboração entre os membros do projeto e os stakeholdersatravés da elaboração Status Report e/ou ações de Gestão da Mudança, a fim de garantir alinhamento, atendimento aos requisitos, entregas acordadas e prazos estabelecidos;
  • Gerenciar testes, pilotos e acompanhar a implantação em produção dos projetos, a fim de garantir a preservação da operação existente;
  • Definir e acompanhar critérios de aceitação nas entregas, a fim de garantir a qualidade e atendimento de expectativas acordadas;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento do projeto, através da análise/custeio dos recursos necessários e dos custos ao longo do projeto, identificando e corrigindo os possíveis desvios;
  • Identificar, acompanhar e atualizar os riscos do projeto através de controle do projeto, dos planos de respostas aos riscos e do plano de gerenciamento, a fim de mitigar e reduzir os impactos;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos pelos fornecedores visando garantir a aderência ao contrato Firmado.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito


Informações da vaga:

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Support & Implementation)
description:
The Role


We are Appointwise. We build high-end AI infrastructure that replaces manual sales teams with autonomous digital workforces. We recently launched Appointwise 2.0 , a visual, node-based platform that allows businesses to architect complex behavior, not just simple chatbots.


We are looking for a Solutions Engineer . This is not a standard customer support role where you read from a script. You are the technical architect for our clients. You will be debugging complex logic flows, building agents live on Zoom to demonstrate capabilities, and solving implementation blockers instantly.


What You Will Do


  • Enterprise & Standard Support: You will manage support across all client tiers. This includes handling complex custom implementations for Enterprise clients while providing efficient, day-to-day troubleshooting for standard users.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: You will diagnose and resolve logic errors, infinite loops, and variable configuration issues within our node-based builder by using back-end logs/systems.
  • Live Implementation: You will join calls with enterprise clients to build and configure custom workflows in real-time, ensuring their agents are set up correctly for deployment.
  • Video-First Resolution: You will manage support tickets with a focus on clarity. Instead of long text replies, you will frequently record Loom videos to visually explain fixes and guide users through the solution.
  • Product Improvement: You will identify recurring bugs and user friction points, reporting them to the engineering team to help prioritize platform updates.


Who We Are Looking For


  • You are an Automation Native: You have deep experience with visual logic builders (Make, n8n, Voiceflow, or GoHighLevel Workflows). You understand JSON, Webhooks, and API payloads.
  • You Explain Complexity Simply: You can explain technical concepts (like how a variable passes data between nodes) to a non-technical business owner without jargon.
  • You are Presentable & Sharp: You are comfortable on camera. You have a professional setup, clear audio, and the ability to think on your feet during live demos.
  • You are \"Inbox Zero\" Obsessed: You hate leaving problems unsolved. You are proactive, fast, and thorough.


Requirements


  • Proven experience building complex automations (Portfolio or examples required).
  • Deep understanding of LLMs (Prompt engineering, Context windows, System prompts).
  • Excellent written and verbal English (Native or C2 level).
  • Been in a previous customer facing technical support roles
  • Ability to work US/EST hours.


How to Apply


We do not just want a cover letter.


  • Record a short Loom video (max 3 minutes).
  • Tell us about the most complex automation you have ever built and your previous support roles.
  • Explain how it worked and why you built it.
  • Send the link along with your CV/Resume.

title: Bilingual DevOps Engineer Remote
description:
DevOps Engineer


Job Description

We are seeking a qualified DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Kubernetes-based systems in our on-premises data center, handling everything from bare metal hardware and networking to database administration and application deployment. You will address the unique challenges of operating a private cloud, including optimizing AI model operations, CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Enterprise Java and Python services. This role involves hands-on operation of production data center racks, ensuring flawless performance and scalability for our AI-based applications.


Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters using Helm diagrams for orchestration and configuration management.

Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Git, Jenkins, and related tools to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes. Manage Postgres and NoSQL databases, including performance tuning, backups, scaling, and security configurations. Manage physical hardware in our data center racks, including provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining servers and network components.

Implement, monitor, and manage enterprise Java and Python applications, ensuring compatibility with our AI models and infrastructure.


Skills

Advanced english level. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems administration, specializing in Kubernetes and container orchestration. Strong command of Helm for Kubernetes application management. Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins for developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Experience administering Postgres databases, including query optimization, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of Enterprise Java and Python programming for application support and scripting. Exceptional mastery of the Linux operating system.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras

Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:

Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)

  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
