title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.

  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Systems Architect – Prediction Market
description:
About the Role

Forkast is a prediction market where crypto traders and gamers predict real-world events. Real-time, high-integrity infrastructure where every millisecond counts. We’re looking for a hands-on Systems Architect to take our trading engine from exceptional to elite.


The ideal candidate has scaled production-grade systems at serious volume. This isn’t a whiteboard-only position. This is a high-stakes engineering role at the intersection of finance, crypto, and frontier prediction market systems design.


You’ll be solving performance bottlenecks, owning major redesigns, and championing best practices in distributed computing.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the evolution of our trading engine, scaling throughput, reliability, and latency.
  • Design and optimize the integration between off-chain matching engines and on-chain settlement (USDC on Arbitrum).
  • Apply industry-standard approaches to distributed systems design, ensuring consistency, fault tolerance, and correctness.
  • Establish and implement robust observability practices, including tracing, metrics, logging, and alerting.
  • Design and scale data storage systems, including database partitioning, sharding, and performance tuning.
  • Guide the team in implementing complex designs correctly through code reviews, technical direction, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Step in as a builder when needed: implement performance-critical components, optimize in-memory order books, and improve messaging and data pipelines.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience scaling high-throughput, low-latency trading systems or similar distributed platforms in production.
  • Deep understanding of trading engine architecture, including settlement, batching, state consistency, and failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with system-level performance optimization and distributed systems.
  • Practical experience setting up and operating monitoring, tracing, and observability tools at scale.
  • Experience designing and scaling databases, including partitioning strategies and data access optimization.
  • Coding alongside the team. Hands-on contributions, not just oversight.
  • Ability to guide a team in adopting industry standards and implementing them consistently.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, decentralized exchanges, or hybrid CeFi/DeFi systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-scale infrastructure, production operations, and large-scale data storage.
  • Familiarity with trading agents using open agent platforms like OpenClaw


Why This Role

  • Directly influence the architecture and scalability of a high-performance trading platform.
  • Work hands-on with top-tier engineers on genuinely hard distributed systems problems.
  • Competitive compensation and equity for a role with real technical ownership and impact.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as

  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions;
    we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ;
    experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia.

Key Requirements:

- Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred)

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

- Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)

- Excellent communication and organizational skills

- Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment

What We Offer:

- Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month)

- Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired

- Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months

- Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results

- Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia

- If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided

- Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team

- Support with relocation and integration in Europe

Key Responsibilities:

- Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

- Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.

- Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.

- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

- Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.

- Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.

- Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).

- Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.

- Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Talent Pool - Persons With Disabilities (Banco De Talentos - Pcd)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕ ES:

Garantir a disponibilidade, funcionamento e correta utilização dos equipamentos críticos (monitores, desfibriladores, ventiladores, carrinhos de emergência, bombas de infusão).
Integrar-se de forma estratégica com equipes médicas, multiprofissionais, regulação de leitos, diagnóstico, UTI, centro cirúrgico e áreas de apoio.
Atuar em conjunto com a CCIH, Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente e Qualidade, assegurando conformidade regulatória e suporte aos processos de acreditação.
Gerenciar materiais, medicamentos e insumos críticos, assegurando abastecimento contínuo, controle de validade e uso racional.
Coordenar planos de contingência para picos de demanda, múltiplas vítimas, desastres e situações de crise.
Garantir o cumprimento das normas legais e éticas da enfermagem (COFEN/COREN, ANVISA, RDCs vigentes).
Promover práticas de humanização no atendimento e comunicação efetiva com pacientes e familiares.
Conduzir auditorias internas, monitorar não conformidades e implementar ações de melhoria contínua.
Fomentar cultura de segurança, agilidade, eficiência e alto desempenho assistencial.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕ ES: Para o exercício do cargo de Coordenador de Enfermagem é imprescindível que o ocupante do cargo tenha registro vigente no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), além de estar com as obrigações financeiras plenamente quitadas no referido conselho.

title: Enterprise Sales Regional Vice President
description:
Included Health is seeking a seasoned Enterprise Sales Executive to lead growth across the Northeast region who will help us further our mission by selling the Included Health suite of products to enterprise customers (1,000-10,000 employee population). As an Enterprise Sales RVP, your role will be to identify, pursue and close business with self-funded employers, within your territory. Through a consultative approach, you will work both directly with senior Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards leadership as well as with their trusted advisors and consultants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory Growth Leadership: Own and expand the Northeast enterprise territory by developing and executing a regional go-to-market strategy focused on large employers and Fortune 1000 companies.
  • Strategic Account Development: Build and manage executive-level relationships with HR, Total Rewards, and Benefits leaders to position Included Health as a trusted partner in improving employee healthcare experiences and outcomes.
  • Complex Enterprise Sales Management: Lead multi-threaded, consultative sales cycles with multiple internal and external stakeholders—C-suite, Procurement, Finance, and third-party consultants to drive consensus and close strategic, long-term contracts.
  • Regional Consultant Engagement: Develop and maintain strong relationships with Northeast-based benefits consultants, brokers, and advisory firms to influence employer purchasing decisions and strengthen Included Health’s market position.
  • Client Expansion: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand Included Health’s service portfolio within existing enterprise clients, driving additional revenue and deeper customer partnerships.
  • Sales Process Optimization: Contribute to continuous improvement of sales frameworks, tools, and playbooks that shorten the sales cycle and enhance team effectiveness in complex deal environments.
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain meticulous CRM documentation, pipeline management, and forecasting accuracy to ensure transparency and accountability across all stages of the sales process.
  • Brand Representation: Serve as a regional ambassador for Included Health’s mission to enable better, more equitable healthcare experiences for employees and their families.
  • Travel: Regularly within the Northeast region to meet with prospects, clients, and consultants; attend industry events and conferences as needed.

During your first 30 days

  • Onboard with the Included Health team, attend GTM training and engage in internal learning.
  • Quickly develop an understanding of our products and become highly knowledgeable with our offerings.
  • Partner with appropriate Included Health DVP to come up to speed quickly on respective market dynamics, targets and opportunities.
  • Begin developing Year 1 Sales plan.
  • Tap your strong network of buyers or influencers to identify major sales opportunities.
  • Ride along with DVP and other sales reps on sales calls for learning purposes.

During your first 60 days

  • Establish your sales territory and familiarize yourself with potential local enterprise customers.
  • Make introductions to your network and future customers regarding Included Health.
  • Work with Included Health DVP to secure meetings with target enterprise organizations and to conduct joint Sales meetings with DVP and/or other senior Sales professionals.

During your first 90 days

  • Establish your sales territory and familiarize yourself with potential local enterprise customers.
  • Make introductions to your network and future customers regarding Included Health.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, with at least 3 years focused on complex sales cycles with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Regional Track Record: Proven success selling to large employers in the Northeast U.S. market, with deep familiarity with regional business, consultant, and benefits ecosystems.
  • Enterprise Sales Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage and close long, complex sales cycles (6–18 months) involving multiple executive stakeholders.
  • Consultative Selling: Skilled at uncovering client pain points, quantifying business impact, and designing tailored solutions that align with strategic benefit and cost-containment goals.
  • Consultant & Channel Relationships: Established network and credibility with leading Northeast benefits consultants and brokers who influence enterprise purchasing decisions.
  • Performance Excellence: Consistent achievement of or surpassing multimillion-dollar annual quotas in the enterprise space.
  • Executive Communication: Exceptional presence, negotiation, and storytelling ability with C-suite audiences.
  • CRM Discipline: Proficiency with Salesforce (or similar) and disciplined pipeline and forecast management.

Salary Range

Zone A: $128,130- $180,990 + equity + benefits

Zone B: $140,943- $199,089 + equity + benefits

Zone C: $153,756- $217,188 + equity + benefits

Zone D: $166,569- $235,287 + equity + benefits

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for candidates based on their respective Zone. Below is additional information on Included Health's commitment to maintaining transparent and equitable compensation practices across our distinct geographic zones.

Starting base salary for you will depend on several job-related factors, unique to each candidate, which may include education; training; skills; years and depth of experience; certifications and licensure; our needs; internal peer equity; organizational considerations; and understanding of geographic and market data. Compensation structures and ranges are tailored to each zone's unique market conditions to ensure that all employees receive fair and great compensation package based on their roles and locations. Your Recruiter can share your geographic zone upon inquiry.

Benefits & Perks

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

  • Remote-first culture
  • 401(k) savings plan through Fidelity
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)
  • Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off ("DTO")
  • 12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave
  • Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.
  • Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.

About Included Health

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in‑person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. It’s all included. Learn more at includedhealth.com .

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI BRASIL possui uma filial do Rio de Janeiro queoperacionaliza e gerencia os projetos desenvolvidos em todo estado, sendo eles: Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição Rio, projetos com a concessionaria LIGHT (LIGHT RECICLA e EXPOSIÇÂO), além de estar em fase de implantação de projeto em parceria com a PETROBRAS e algumas iniciativas em costrução com alta probabilidade de se concretizar. Efetuar o abastecimento da manufatura, transferindo os materiais e insumos locados em estoque, utilizando equipamentos apropriados para a movimentação, garantindo a continuidade do processo produtivo.

Abastecer produto acabado segregado na área destinada ao reprocessamento de produto, respeitando as datas de vencimento e tipo, possibilitando que o produto destinado ao reprocessamento não vença em estoque e gere custo de descarte.

Movimentar os bags de café torrado e/ou torrado e moído destinados a descarte para as áreas corretas, possibilitando a correta destinação do café não conforme e assim evitando o uso não intencional pelas áreas de produção.

Você criará um grande diferencial em seu currículo, dentro de uma empresa que acompanha e treina continuamente para ajudar você a se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmo.

Ao se tornar um G.O Gerente de Restaurantes, você poderá aproveitar as instalações e atividades oferecidas pelo Club Med. E, se quiser, poderá até subir ao palco para mostrar seus talentos!

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Descrição da vaga

Realizar conferência dos produtos utilizando sistema específico, garantindo controle assertivo das entradas e saídas dos produtos de forma físicas e sistêmicas.

Acompanhar e conferir os paletes produzidos que são entregues no armazém, prestando suporte no controle da liberação ou bloqueio da área de Qualidade por turno de trabalho, visando assegurar o recebimento assertivo da quantidade produzida e o controle de recebimento.

Efetuar contagem física diária das quantidades liberadas no estoque, a fim de manter estoque controlado bem como apoiar a área administrativa com informações para confronto físico versus contábil.

Realizar a leitura da carga para expedição e controle de rastreabilidade.

Preencher checklist em formulário específico para liberação dos veículos, assegurando o atendimento as normas de segurança, segurança da carga, multas e exigências de qualidade.

Participar em inventários, informando as contagens dos produtos por família e quantidade apurada, atendendo as necessidades da empresa para controle e redução de custos com perda de estoque.

Verificar lista de exigência cadastrada para outbound de clientes, informando as datas permanecentes no estoques, a fim de apurar a validade dos produtos no FIFO (First In, First Out), visando o atendimento correto dos lotes de validade cadastrados para os clientes e informativo interno de controle.

Movimentação de Materiais

Operar equipamento de movimentação, como empilhadeira frontal, empilhadeira retrátil e transpaleteira conforme demanda e permissão de uso, garantindo o atendimento da demanda de produção e logística para dar continuidade no processo de armazenagem, distribuição e produção.

Efetuar checklist do equipamento, inspecionando todos os pontos no início da atividade, visando conservar o bom estado de funcionamento do equipamento ou identificar necessidades de manutenção preventiva, evitando assim prejudicar a produtividade dos equipamentos e comprometer a segurança de sua operação e das pessoas que o rodeiam.

Abastecer a linha de paletização com paletes vazios, respeitando a quantidade limitada, atendendo ao processo produtivo.

Retirar os paletes prontos da linha de paletização e realizar o strechamento dos mesmos quando necessário, verificando se está dentro do padrão de qualidade preestabelecido e efetuando todos os tramites de rastreabilidade do produto.

Realizar a armazenagem dos paletes produzidos, utilizando equipamento apropriado para movimentação dos mesmos e seguindo os padrões do estoque, prezando pela organização da área.

Separar cargas, conforme demanda e orientação, posicionando a mesma no local indicado para que seja realizado o carregamento, além de efetuar o carregamento com equipamento apropriado, garantindo a vazão do produto acabado e atendimento do cliente.

Colocar a empilhadeira/transpaleteira no conector para iniciar o processo de carga do equipamento.

Movimentar os paletes no estoque, conforme orientação para armazenamento e movimentações dos produtos diante das necessidades da área, facilitando a disponibilidade dos produtos liberados para inventário, venda ou transferência.

Descarregar os paletes com produtos recebidos em veículos, possibilitando a conferência para abastecimento do estoque, retornos ou devoluções de outras operações de clientes.

Prestar suporte no recebimento de materiais, descarregando caminhões quando necessário, conferindo notas fiscais e pedido, bem como efetuando lançamento no sistema informatizado, garantindo o abastecimento da fábrica e controle preciso dos materiais e insumos.

Efetuar o abastecimento da manufatura, transferindo os materiais e insumos locados em estoque, utilizando equipamentos apropriados para a movimentação, garantindo a continuidade do processo produtivo.

Controlar estoque, através de sistema informatizado e planilhas eletrônicas, mantendo as informações atualizadas, bem como efetuar contagem do estoque de insumos e peças técnicas, registrando a informação em relatório próprio para posterior conferência com o sistema, assegurando que o estoque esteja em conformidade com o sistema.

Providenciar, quando demandado, entrega de EPIs, uniformes e peças técnicas, seguindo procedimentos preestabelecidos, com o objetivo de disponibilizar o recurso necessário e obrigatórios.

Abastecer produto acabado segregado na área destinada ao reprocessamento de produto, respeitando as datas de vencimento e tipo, possibilitando que o produto destinado ao reprocessamento não vença em estoque e gere custo de descarte.
